name: Thrill
description: Gain 16 Adaptive Attack

name: Swift
description: Gain 10% extra Attack Speed

name: Wilderness Blessing
description:
Extra Movement Speed in Jungle and River
Movement Speed in the Jungle and Rive is increased by 10%. This bonus is halved when in combat wih enemy heroes, Lord or Turtle

name: Seasoned Hunter
description:
Increase Jungling Speed
Damage against Lord and Turtle is increased by 15%. This bonus is halved against regular Creeps and doesn't affect the damage of Retribution.

name: Impure Rage
description:
Extra Skill Damage & Restore Mana on Hit
Dealing damage with skills deals 4% of target's Max HP extra Adaptive Damage and restores 2% Mana on hit.
If the hero does not use Mana restores 1% HP instead. The extra Adaptive Damage dealt to non-hero units is up to 120.
Cooldown: 5s.

name: Quantum Charge
description:
Basic Attacks Grant HP Regen & Speed Up
Dealing damage with Basic Attacks increases Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s and restores 75-180HP (scales with level).
Cooldown: 8s.

name: War Cry
description:
Increase Sustained Dmaage
After every 3 Separate Basic Attacks or skill hit an enemy hero, all damage dealt increases by 8% for 6s.
A single Basic ATtack or skill that deals damage multiple times only count as 1
Cooldown: 6s.

name: Temporal Reign
description:
Non-Ultimate Skills Cooldown Reduction
The next Ultimate cast decreases other active skills' remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times within 4s. This effect is extended by 2s after getting hero kills or assists
This only applies to the hero themselves
Cooldown: 20s.

name: Vitality
description: Gain 225 extra max HP.

name: Tenacity
description:
Increase Defense at Low HP
When HP is below 50%, Physical & Magic Defense are increased by 15

name: Concussive Blast
description:
HP-Based AOE Damage
After the next Basic Attack, deal 100(+7% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies
Cooldown: 15s

name: Rupture
description:
Give 5 Adaptive Penetration
Gain Physical Penetration if extra Physical Attack is higher than extra Magic Power, otherwise, gain Magic Penetration.

name: Master Assassin
description:
Increase Damage to Lone Heroes
if there is only one enemy hero nearby, damage dealt to them is increased by 7%

name: Killing Spree
description:
Regen and Speed Up After Dealing Damage
When damaging heroes below 30% HP, instantly recover 15% of Lost HP and gain 20% Movement Speed.
Additional Effect: Reset cooldown upon killing an enemy hero.
Duration: 3s
Cooldown: 30s

name: Inspire
description: Cooldown Reduction is increased by 5% and Mana Regen by 2.

name: Bargain Hunter
description:
Reduce Equipment Cost
Equipment can be purchased at 95% of their base price.

name: Lethal Ignition
description:
Extra Damage on Multi-Hits
Dealing damage greater than 7% of an enemy hero's Max HP 3 times within 5s will scorch the target for an additional 162-750 Adaptive Damage (scales with level).
Cooldown: 15s.

name: Firmness
description: Gain 8 extra Physical & Magic Defense.

name: Festival of Blood
description:
Get Extra Spell Vamp
Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each hero kill or assist grant an additional 0.5% Spell Vamp, up to 12 stacks

name: Brave Smite
description:
Skill Damage Grants HP Regen
Dealing skill damage to an enemy hero recovers 5% Max HP.
Cooldown: 6s.

name: Agility
description: Gain 4% extra Movement Speed.

name: Pull Yourself Together
description:
Reduce Battle Spell & Active Equipment CD
Cooldowns of Battle Spells and equipment's active skills are reduced by 12% initially. Each hero kill or assist grants an additional 1% reduction, up to 8 stacks.

name: Focusing Mark
description:
Enhance Ally Damage
After damaging an enemy hero, allied heroes deal 6% more damage to them and gain 10% Movement Speed.
Duration: 3s
Cooldown: 4s

name: Fatal
description: Gain 5% Crit Chance and 5% extra Crit Damage.

name: Weapon Master
description:
Bonus Extra Attack
Physical Attack and Magic Power gained from equipment, emblem, talents, and skills are increased by 8%.

name: Weakness Finder
description:
Basic Attack Slow Enemies
Basic Attacks slow enemies by 50% and reduce their Attack Speed by 30%.
Duration: 1s.
Cooldown: 10s (each Basic Attack reduces it by 1s, down to 3s).
